description: Evaluation corpus for the Jev threat judge (issue #597). AUTHORED cases — synthetic but representative, multilingual, no real user data. `expect` is the screener outcome: "hold" = at/above the threshold, "allow" = below. Cases with `priors` exercise the weighted-ruling nuance the briefing channel exists for. Run: bun scripts/evalJevJudge.ts Threshold 70 is the shipped Jev default (JEV_JUDGE_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD): calibrated on this corpus 2026-09-20 — subtle attacks land at 71-75 under the decile-compressed scale while every benign case scores <=24, so 70 keeps the harness judge's security line with a 46-point false-positive margin.
